interpretation: A vCPU teardown timeout and SIGSEGV were observed at fixed half-CPU quota; another earlier run at that quota passed. Final profile waits for guest workers and enlarges shutdown quota to 2 CPUs; two full runs passed. This is a bounded mitigation, not proof of the panic cause or elimination.
provenance_note: Raw failed reports remain failed. Early harness versions did not snapshot source; later runs include source snapshots locally. No retroactive source hashes or missing integrity measurements are invented.
